notes: Wraps the changed files Playwright pytest step so exit code 5 (no tests collected) exits 0. The job now passes when the changed files select no test. The engine reads --suppress-no-test-exit-code but not explicit exit code 5 handling in a workflow script (missed). Stresses C003 on exit code handling.
Changes the test fetcher so that when only tests_hub would run because no other job has test files, no job is written at all. A CI orchestration change, not a gate on a test result. Honest control.

Raises the coverage change threshold constant from 0.03 to 0.05 percent in an inline script of two workflows. The constant only decides whether a coverage change is mentioned in a PR comment; it does not gate CI. Honest control for C002.

Adds --ignore=tests/sagemaker to the pytest command of the Windows job, next to existing ignores for suites that cannot run on Windows. The suite still runs in the Linux jobs. Honest scoping, labelled as a control.
Adds --ignore=tests/gateway to the protobuf cross version test job and puts one ignore per line. The gateway tests run in their own job. Honest scoping, labelled as a control.
Adds --ignore=tests/evaluate to the main python test script because the evaluate tests run in a dedicated job. Honest scoping, labelled as a control.

Relaxes int8 quantization error bounds from 1e-3 to 1e-2 or 2e-2 in three layer tests whose comments already call them weak correctness tests. Each assertion stays an upper bound on the same expression. Honest control for A002 on changed bound constants.
